user.title: SolarEdge V2 test
user.description: Use a SolarEdge Monitoring API app with Site Access, SITE_DATA and http://localhost:8080/oauth/callback as its redirect URL.

callback.title: Authorize site access
callback.description: Open the [SolarEdge sign-in]({authorize_url}) on the same device. Approve access and copy the full localhost URL from the address bar, even if the page shows a connection error.

error.invalid_input: Check the Client ID, Client Secret and production start date.
error.invalid_callback: Use the full localhost URL from this sign-in.

abort.wrong_site: Select the same SolarEdge site as before.
abort.insufficient_permissions: SolarEdge denied access. Check that the app allows SITE_DATA and, for device discovery, DEVICE_DATA.
abort.authorization_failed: SolarEdge rejected the authorization. Check your app credentials and start a fresh sign-in.
abort.cannot_connect: SolarEdge did not return a usable production total. Start setup again.

init.title: Local power measurements
init.description: Optionally select existing power sensors. For grid power, positive means import and negative means export.

data.local_grid_power: Local grid power (for example, a P1 meter)
